subject.title: Add option to hide session status card

question: Should OpenClaw add a core status-card visibility config for chat `/status` and `session_status`, and should it hide the whole card or only privacy-sensitive sections such as usage and cost?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent config key, output shape, privacy boundary, and docs contract are product/security choices rather than a narrow bug repair.

options.title: Add a documented visibility contract
options.body: Introduce a default-on setting or section allowlist that preserves current output while allowing operators to suppress the chat/tool status card or sensitive lines.

options.title: Limit suppression to privacy sections
options.body: Add a narrower usage/cost suppression setting if maintainers want to solve the sensitive-data concern without creating a broad status-card mode.

options.title: Reject the new config surface
options.body: Keep status cards always visible and close the request as not planned if maintainers decide the extra configuration is not worth the complexity.

recommendation.title: Add a documented visibility contract
recommendation.body: Introduce a default-on setting or section allowlist that preserves current output while allowing operators to suppress the chat/tool status card or sensitive lines.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the original `session_status` surface and already framed this issue as the canonical product tracker in the discussion.
